channel.title: Handy Calcs: Free Calculators
channel.description: Free calculators and online tools for tips, pay, budgets, loans, QR codes, images and text.

item.title: How to Calculate Food Cost Percentage for a Restaurant (and Price Your Menu)
item.description: The food cost percentage formula for a single dish and for a whole month, typical targets, how to set menu prices from cost, and ways to lower food cost. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.

item.title: Strong Password Generator (Random, Free, Private)
item.description: Create strong random passwords with letters, numbers and symbols. Choose the length, avoid look-alike characters and see the strength. Nothing is sent or saved.

item.title: Compound Interest Explained Simply (With Examples and the Rule of 72)
item.description: What compound interest is, the formula, how compounding frequency and time change the result, the rule of 72, and how it works against you with debt. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.

item.title: How to Pay Off Credit Card Debt Faster: Avalanche vs. Snowball
item.description: Why minimum payments take so long, how much interest you really pay, and two proven ways to pay off credit cards faster: the avalanche and snowball methods. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.

item.title: Random Name Picker Wheel: Spin to Choose (Free)
item.description: Type names, spin the wheel and get a fair random winner. Great for classrooms, raffles, giveaways and deciding who goes first. Free.

item.title: The 50/30/20 Budget Rule Explained (With Real Examples)
item.description: How the 50/30/20 budget works: what counts as needs, wants and savings, examples at different incomes, and how to adjust it when rent takes too much. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.
